description: Pure HTTP passthrough, fixed at the offering level to the platform's sink test receiver (no customer_secrets, no enrollment). Exists purely as gateway-reachable infrastructure for the post-deploy smoke test (unitysvc-k8s gateway-smoke workflow): it gives any caller that needs to prove it can reach the API gateway a stable, always-on route whose upstream is the sink test receiver, verifiable by polling sink's own `/retrieve` API. Not intended for real relay use — the destination is always the same shared test sink.
name: http-to-sink
summary: Gateway smoke-test only: fixed HTTP passthrough to the platform's sink test receiver.
